annotations.title: Get EDGAR completeness summary for a company

description:
Return a minimal completeness summary for a company, including the latest filing identifiers and how many statements each statement type has.

Deterministic ordering: latest filing by filing date desc, with a fixed tie-break; statement types sorted asc.

cik.description: Company CIK as digits (for example 0000320193), or a ticker symbol (for example AAPL). A ticker resolves to the company whose filings hold its statements as of the request's as-of or period-end date, or as of today when the request has none.

name: edgar_companies_completeness
